title: Take a picture of your screen
aliases: how do i take a screenshot
save a picture of my screen
capture what is on my phone
keep a copy of this screen

steps.instruction: Give the side button and volume up button one quick press together, releasing straight away.
steps.ui_label_hint: side button and volume up button

steps.instruction: Tap the tick icon in the screen picture that appears.

source_note: iPhone screenshot controls on iOS 26/27, English, October 2026 documentation review. Start on the screen to capture. Main path: Face ID iPhone with full-screen previews enabled. Home button iPhones use side button + Home instead of side button + volume up. If thumbnail previews are enabled, the image saves automatically. Check the tick menu and Save to Photos wording. The first hint names physical buttons, not an on-screen label. Not checked on a phone. Source: https://support.apple.com/en-au/guide/iphone/iphc872c0115/26/ios/26
